In our offline evaluation of 84 queries, the revised retriever achieved Recall@10 of 0.72, compared with 0.75 for the baseline [4]. Median latency decreased from 93 ms to 68 ms, while peak memory use increased by 7%. These findings may indicate a speed–recall trade-off under this configuration. We did not evaluate multilingual queries, and the results do not establish that the revised retriever is preferable in production.
本研究在36次离线试验中观察到缓存命中率与响应延迟呈负相关（r = −0.41）。这一结果并不能证明提高命中率会导致延迟下降。与配置A相比，配置B的中位延迟减少了8 ms，但错误率由1.2%升至1.8%。两组吞吐量的差异未达到统计显著性。当前试验未覆盖移动网络，后续验证尚未开展。
